restoration_note: This kephalaion narrates the cosmogonic prayer-cycle: the Mother of Life (= the divine principle of life-bearing in the Lord) prays to the Father for the First Man (= the Divine Human) who has descended into affliction in the land of darkness; the Father sends the Living Spirit (the operative power and 'Expander') to raise him; afterwards the same five gather and intercede for the living soul still mingled in the fleshes of death, whereupon the Father sends the Third Ambassador, who chooses her forth and sets her on her feet in joy; finally Jesus the Radiance is named as completing the purpose of heart of the elements. The first half (sections 5300–5382) is largely intact and the editor's letter-completions are secure (morphological completions of known Manichaean technical vocabulary: ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ, ⲡⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ, ⲣⲉϩϯⲟⲩⲁⲥⲧⲛ̄, ⲡⲍⲩⲡⲟⲁⲟⲝⲉⲩⲥ, ⲡⲁⲛⲭⲱⲭ, ϯⲩⲭⲏ, ⲁⲣⲉⲧϥ̄/ⲁⲣⲉⲧⲥ̄ idioms). Sections 5383–5407 are extensively rubbed off; only short editor-flagged completions (ⲁⲩⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ, ⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ, ϣⲁ ⲁⲛⲏⲍⲉ, ⲡⲗⲁⲥⲙⲁ, ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ) are recoverable. The closing exhortation (5423) addresses the audience: 'you stand fast on your feet,' linking the cosmogonic prayer to the hearer's regeneration.
